name: test-support-helper-cycle
description: Test-support code is the largest set of files the definition admits, so two helper files that import each other and that only a test reaches are both test code, although each one's importers include the other. The helper a test calls and the helper only the other helper calls are live, and the default minimum confidence withholds what is reported about them, a production function only the second helper file calls is reported as test-only use in a component of its own, because a reference from test-support code is a test reference, and a helper function nothing calls is reported under the unused code its visibility selects.
